description: Primary skill for Integration Architecture and Contract Design. Trigger when translating System of Record (SoR) data (from discovery_expert) into System of Engagement (SoE) mobile contracts (from ui_analyzer). Use for: 1. Mapping UI tokens to API payloads. 2. Mobile-first optimization (flattening, pruning). 3. Enforcing enterprise security (PII masking) and API standards. DO NOT use for: Writing database queries or creating frontend UI components. REQUIRES: ./discovery/specs/ and ./ui_analysis/ui_requirements_spec.md.

tools.name: mobile_api_standards
tools.description: Enforces strict camelCase, payload formatting, and mobile envelope structures.

tools.name: security_data_masking
tools.description: Lists forbidden internal database fields and PII scrubbing rules.

tools.name: figma_extraction_rules
tools.description: Guides visual or layout analysis of Figma designs/screenshots to map mandatory UI fields, UI states, lists, and nullability parameters.

runtime_directives.description: If a live Figma interface link is provided via supported workspace integrations, analyze layout tokens. Otherwise, request a screenshot and perform visual analysis for required data properties.
